message.content:
TV wall mounting brackets of steel: CBP rulings have classified them in 8302.49 (base metal mountings, fittings suitable for furniture, etc.), or in 8302.42 ("other mountings, fittings, and similar articles, suitable for furniture"). Others have classified TV mounts in 8529.90 as parts of TVs, but the usual ruling is that a TV bracket is not a part of the TV, so it goes to 8302.49. Full-motion steel mounts: HTS 8302.49.6085 is "Other: Of other base metal: Other". Subheading 8302.49.60 covers "Other" (other than aluminum, which is 8302.49.40 "Of aluminum"). 8302.49.6035 is "Other: Of iron or steel"? Let me recall: 8302.49.60 "Other" has statistical suffixes 8302.49.6045 "Of iron or steel; Other" ... From memory, the rulings on steel TV mounts cite 8302.49.6085. I'll go with 8302.49.6085.

{"hts_code": "8302.49.6085", "reason": "A steel TV wall mounting bracket is a base-metal mounting/fitting of heading 8302 that is not of aluminum and not a TV part, so it falls in the 8302.49.60 residual provision."}
